# gtm_link_destination (Action)

Adds a Destination to this Container and removes it from the Container to which it is currently linked.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent` (String) GTM parent Container's API relative path.

### Optional

- `allow_user_permission_feature_update` (Boolean) Must be set to true to allow features.user_permissions to change from false to true. If this operation causes an update but this bit is false, the operation will fail.
- `destination_id` (String) Destination ID to be linked to the current container.
